This '''Imperial officer''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The Imperial officer briefed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on various operation against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] around the time of [[Operation Skyhook]] and the [[Battle of Hoth (0 BBY)|Battle of Hoth]] up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Behind the scenes==
This officer appears in the cutscenes of ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' and informs Vader (who is always depicted in his [[Meditation chamber/Legends|Meditation chamber]]) on the progress of the game. Some of the lines exchanged between him and Vader are taken from the [[Original trilogy|movies]] although in the original dialogues, Vader was in another location and addressed other officers.

The Imperial officer addresses Vader in the following occasions:
*To report that [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] is captured
*To inform Vader that the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] were not found, but an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] was jettisoned without life signs (this dialogue is made with [[Nahdonnis Praji]] onboard the ''Tantive IV'' in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']])
*To excuse about not finding the Rebels on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], adding that the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] would soon locate them. Vader responded that he is not interested in his excuses.

The officer's face is composited from footage of [[LucasArts]] artist [[Sean Turner]], superimposed over footage from the original trilogy.<ref name="RA:TOIG">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault: The Official Insider's Guide]]''</ref>
